prerequisites: General requirements for access to the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the concept of a company, types of companies, and the environment in which they operate.
Be able to understand the different subsystems that integrate a company.
Understand the principles of business organization and management.

syllabus_topics: Functioning of economic activity and types of markets
Concept and objectives of the company
Types of companies: economic, organizational, and legal criteria
Asset and results analysis for decision making
Valuation of investment and financing projects
teaching_methods: Case analysis from document reading and video viewing
Presentation of individual or group assignments

assessment_methods.method: Participation (P) in class and assignment submission

assessment_rules: The ordinary evaluation consists of a final theoretical-practical exam (EX.ORD) worth a maximum of 6.5 points, requiring a minimum of 2.6 points. Three assessable practices (P1, P2, P3) and participation (P) have a combined maximum of 3.5 points, requiring a minimum of 1.4 points. The final grade is the sum of these components (EX.ORD + P1 + P2 + P3 + P); a minimum total of 5 points is required to pass, provided all minimums are met. If the final grade exceeds 5 points but a minimum was not met, the final grade will be 4 points. For extraordinary calls, students can take a theoretical-practical exam (EX.EXTR) and/or a practical exam (EX.PR), with previous scores for EX.ORD and P1+P2+P3+P carried over if minimums were met.
